def solve_m(m):
    T = np.array([[1, 1, 1], [1, 0, 1], [1, 1, 0]], dtype=object)
    if m == 1:
        return 3
    
    # T^(m-1)
    T_m_1 = np.linalg.matrix_power(T.astype(float), m-1) # This will be float
    # Use integer powers to be safe
    def matrix_pow(A, p):
        res = np.eye(A.shape[0], dtype=object)
        while p > 0:
            if p % 2 == 1:
                res = np.dot(res, A)
            A = np.dot(A, A)
            p //= 2
        return res

    T_m_1 = matrix_pow(T, m-1)
    total_sum = np.sum(T_m_1)
    sub = T_m_1[2, 1]
    return total_sum - sub

import numpy as np

def matrix_pow(A, p):
    res = np.eye(A.shape[0], dtype=object)
    while p > 0:
        if p % 2 == 1:
            res = np.dot(res, A)
        A = np.dot(A, A)
        p //= 2
    return res
